devdoc.details: A paused bStock cannot be transferred. Liquidations still seize its vTokens, but no one can redeem them      for the bStock until the pause ends, so liquidators cannot exit. Zeroing CF stops new debt against the      collateral, while the liquidation threshold (LT) is left unchanged so existing positions are not pushed      into liquidation.      - Any market EBrake can act on: EBrake acts on the market's own comptroller and checks the listing there.      - The pause is read from the PauseManager the token itself points to (pauseManager()), which is the        one the token checks before every transfer.      - A sanctioned or blocklisted vToken can neither send nor receive the token, which blocks redeems and        mints just like a pause, so it is treated as one. The block is read by running the same        checkIsCompliant call the token makes, on the compliance module it points to (compliance()); any        revert there counts as blocked.      - Tighten-only: CF is restored by a governance VIP that reads EBrake.getMarketCFSnapshot() and then        calls EBrake.resetCFSnapshot().      - handleBStockPause is called by trusted keepers; EBrake makes repeat calls no-ops.

BStockPauseHandled(address,address,addre.details: Emitted on every handleBStockPause call that finds the token paused or the market blocked, including      repeat calls on a market whose CF is already zero (EBrake then makes no change and emits no      CollateralFactorDecreased event)

params.pauseManager: The PauseManager the underlying token points to

Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

params.monitored: True if the market was added, false if it was removed

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

checkBStockPause(address).details: Returns zeros for a market that is not monitored, and isPaused = false for an underlying token with      no PauseManager. Reads the PauseManager the token itself points to. While the token is not paused, also      runs the token's compliance check for the market; a revert there counts as blocked.      Reverts if the underlying token does not expose pauseManager() or compliance().

returns.isPaused: True if the market is monitored and its underlying token is paused, or the token's         compliance module rejects the market (sanctioned, or blocklisted for the token)
returns.pauseManager: The PauseManager the token points to, or address(0) if the market is not monitored or         the token has none
returns.underlying: The market's underlying token, or address(0) if the market is not monitored

returns._0: The monitored market addresses, in no particular order

handleBStockPause(address).custom:event: Emits BStockPauseHandled when the token is paused or the market blocked
handleBStockPause(address).details: Calls EBrake.decreaseCF(market, 0), which zeroes CF in the market's pool (on the BSC Core pool, also      in every e-mode pool the market is listed in), keeps LT and snapshots the previous CF/LT. Repeat calls      are no-ops in EBrake. The pause and the compliance block are read through checkBStockPause; while      neither holds the call does nothing.      Reverts if the underlying token does not expose pauseManager() or compliance().

returns._0: True if the market is monitored

userdoc.notice: Keeper-driven sentinel that zeroes the collateral factor (CF) of monitored bStock (tokenized equity)         markets through EBrake while the issuer's PauseManager reports the token as paused, or the token's         compliance module sanctions or blocklists the market.
